0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Weald fires true-damage projectiles when Drongo damages a hero below 30% health, once per hero every ten seconds, which suits a carry who finishes fights. Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill. Wind-Rider grants attack speed after a dash, and Pacifier's active is a dash, so the two can chain on paper; whether that lined up is not recorded. The more common pairing swaps Wind-Rider for Taproot's on-hit healing, buying sustain in long fights at the cost of burst after a dash.

ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.quote: Soulbinder adds bonus damage to ability hits from long range and grows Magical Power each time it triggers. Truesilver Bracelet shields Gideon on ultimate cast and makes him immune to crowd control while the shield holds, a direct answer to Grux's stuns and Kwang's knockup during Black Hole. Oblivion Crown multiplies the power. Against the Azure Core, Combustion and Wraith Leggings core, this trades area burst for range and channel safety.

ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.quote: Nihil grows Greystone's stats while he keeps damaging heroes and makes part of that growth permanent on takedowns, which suits a frontline who stays in long fights.
